title: A Dynamical Low-rank Multilevel Monte Carlo Estimator for High-Dimensional Kinetic Equations
summary: Kinetic equations are used to model a wide range of phenomena important for real-world applications. Their applications span astrophysics, nuclear physics, engineering, and social sciences. Due to their high-dimensional phase space, modelling and quantifying uncertainties, relevant for applications, poses a significant challenge even for modern computing infrastructure.
